{{Short description|36th season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 1966–67 National Hurling League |image = |dates = 2 October 1966 – 1 October 1967 |teams = 28 |team1 = Wexford |captain1 = |manager1 = |titles = 3rd |team2 = |captain2 = |manager2 = |two = Kerry |three = Louth |previous = [[1965–66 National Hurling League|1965–66]] |next = [[1967–68 National Hurling League|1967–68]] }} The '''1966–67 National Hurling League''' was the 36th season of the [[National Hurling League]]. ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |season=1966-67 |winners=[[Wexford GAA|Wexford]]

[[Offaly GAA|Offaly]] joined Division 1 as the promoted team. On 28 May 1967, [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] won the title after a 3-10 to 1-9 win over [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] in the final. It was their 3rd league title overall and their first since [[1957-58 National Hurling League|1957-58]].{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} In spite of finishing at the bottom of their respective groups, neither [[Galway GAA|Galway]] of [[Laois GAA|Laois]] were relegated as there was no promotion-relegation this season.
